metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: Sampled mean pairwise item-embedding cosine mapped from [-1,1] to [0,1]. A value near 0.5 means mean cosine near zero; larger values indicate directional alignment. This is not recommendation diversity, effective rank, or evidence of unobserved simulator traits. Null means unavailable.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive-minus-negative score on valid training-loader positions. Describes fitted-model separation, not independent generalization. Null means no observations.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: Lower empirical tenth percentile of observed training score margins; null means no observations.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of valid training positions with negative score above positive score; null means no observations.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of valid training margins below eps=0.5. Depends on score scale; null means no observations.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Observed valid, low-margin and wrong-rank position counts. Category lists remain empty because category metadata is unavailable, not because no errors occurred. These diagnostics do not replace pinned host validation HR@10.
